Empty fields are cleared from the metadata. Document content is never modified.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file.
  2. The current title, author, subject and keywords appear below ("not set" if empty).
  3. Edit the fields you want to change.
  4. Click "Save metadata" and download the updated PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will other PDF readers see my changes?

Yes — title, author, subject and keywords are written into the document's info dictionary, so other PDF readers and search tools will see them.

What happens to fields I leave empty?

Fields left empty are cleared from the metadata. Only the four editable fields are touched; the document content is never altered.

Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?

No. Your PDF is read and rewritten entirely in your browser with PDF-Lib; it is never uploaded.
